baseline.label: Baseline toxicants
baseline.interpretation: Validated for chemicals acting predominantly through baseline narcosis.

less_inert.label: Less-inert toxicants
less_inert.interpretation: Use only when the less-inert mode assignment is scientifically justified; uncertainty is larger and mode classification is decisive.

reactive.label: Reactive toxicants
reactive.interpretation: Evidence-review only. A phase-partitioning critical-burden model is not an adequate predictor for specifically reactive toxicity.

PE.label: PE / LDPE
PE.description: Polyethylene; the source data primarily represent low-density polyethylene.

PDMS.source: Sprunger et al., J. Chromatogr. A 2007, 1175, 162-173
PDMS.notes: Archived equation record; not intended for siloxanes or highly fluorinated compounds. Kinetic suitability requires separate judgment.

PA.notes: Literature-data equation used by the paper; not intended for siloxanes or highly fluorinated compounds.

POM.source: Endo et al., Environ. Sci. Technol. 2011, 45, 10124-10132
POM.notes: Literature-data equation used by the paper; not intended for siloxanes or highly fluorinated compounds.

PE.method: Abraham solvation model / published PE-water LFER
PE.notes: The normalized dashboard preserves the equation used in the supporting workbook; consult the cited source before extrapolation.

PU.method: Thermodynamic cycle from PU-air and air-water ASM equations
PU.notes: PU-water was not available as a direct ASM equation; the paper used a thermodynamic cycle.

PDMS.label: TPM-SI-derived PDMS-water screening LFER
PDMS.source: Regression fitted by the dashboard to paired EPI Suite logKow and ASM-predicted PDMS-water logK values in the TPM nonreactive supporting-data cohorts.
PDMS.notes: This is a transparent one-parameter fallback, not a published TPM equation. Prefer measured K or the paper's Abraham solvation model.

PA.label: TPM-SI-derived PA-water screening LFER
PA.source: Regression fitted by the dashboard to paired EPI Suite logKow and ASM-predicted PA-water logK values in the TPM nonreactive supporting-data cohorts.
PA.notes: This is a transparent one-parameter fallback, not a published TPM equation. Prefer measured K or the paper's Abraham solvation model.

POM.label: TPM-SI-derived POM-water screening LFER
POM.source: Regression fitted by the dashboard to paired EPI Suite logKow and ASM-predicted POM-water logK values in the TPM nonreactive supporting-data cohorts.
POM.notes: This is a transparent one-parameter fallback, not a published TPM equation. Prefer measured K or the paper's Abraham solvation model.

PE.label: Published PE-water logKow LFER (Eq. 14)
PE.source: Khawar & Nabi, ACS Omega 2021, Eq. 14: log KPE-water = -0.696 + 1.059 logKow.
PE.notes: Published for simple neutral organics. The source found the Abraham/polyparameter model more accurate, so use this as a screening fallback when descriptors or measured K are unavailable.

PU.label: TPM-SI-derived PU-water screening LFER
PU.source: Regression fitted by the dashboard to paired EPI Suite logKow and ASM/thermodynamic-cycle PU-water logK values in the TPM nonreactive supporting-data cohorts.
PU.notes: This is a transparent one-parameter fallback, not a published TPM equation. Prefer measured K or the paper's Abraham solvation workflow.

PDMS.passive_sampling: Established absorptive sampler material with broad use for neutral hydrophobic organics.
PDMS.passive_dosing: Commonly used as a controllable donor phase.
PDMS.practical_note: Validation error is higher than PA and POM in the full baseline validation cohort.

PA.passive_sampling: Strong enrichment can support trace analysis when the chemical-specific partition coefficient is favorable.
PA.passive_dosing: Usable as an absorptive phase when loading and partition data are available.
PA.practical_note: One of the two strongest TPM phases for baseline fish-LC50 prediction.

POM.passive_sampling: Well-characterized equilibrium partition phase for many neutral organics.
POM.passive_dosing: Can be used when slower material diffusion is addressed experimentally.
POM.practical_note: One of the two strongest TPM phases for baseline fish-LC50 prediction.

PE.passive_sampling: Widely used for field sampling of hydrophobic organic contaminants.
PE.passive_dosing: Applicable when donor loading and exposure maintenance are verified.
PE.practical_note: The paper data primarily represent LDPE; do not silently transfer performance to every PE grade.

PU.passive_sampling: Potentially useful for chemicals with broader intermolecular interactions.
PU.practical_note: PU-water partition values were obtained through a thermodynamic cycle and carry added model dependence.

scientific_limits: The TPM predicts acute fish LC50 from equilibrium plastic-water partitioning and a mode-specific median critical burden.
Predictions require a neutral organic chemical, a defensible toxic mode, and an equilibrium phase-partition coefficient.
Ionizable chemicals, mixtures without equilibrium, polymers outside the validated set, and specifically reactive chemicals require separate evaluation.
Other-plastic results from Table S6 are exploratory and are not enabled in the calculator.
